subject: Pricing & context-sizing: token buckets, budget targets and next steps
messages:
From: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@novacorp.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on token profile and pricing (post-call)

Logan / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying items so we can take this to procurement: 

1) Usage sketch (monthly):
   - Monthly active users (MAU): ~10k
   - Avg sessions per MAU: 1.8 (some users call the assistant multiple times)
   - Avg interactions per session: 2.7 (prompt -> short follow-up -> completion)

2) Token profile (rough averages from our sample logs):
   - Avg prompt tokens per interaction: ~95 tokens (includes system prompt + user)
   - Avg completion tokens per interaction: ~640 tokens
   - Combined avg tokens per interaction: ~735 tokens

3) Context length needs:
   - 70% of interactions use short context (<=8k)
   - 25% need extended context (~32k) for multi-document answers
   - 5% require long context (~128k) for large document retrievals / summaries

4) Volume scenarios (monthly tokens):
   - Conservative: 50M tokens
   - Expected: 320M tokens
   - Upside: 1.2B tokens

5) Budget target / procurement ask: their finance team prefers to see target unit economics in the range of $300–$400 per 1M tokens (flat, blended) with the option to commit for a predictable discount.

Next steps we need from Redwood: a short note that maps our token buckets to recommended model variants (8k / 32k / 128k), an example blended price that hits the $/1M target (or close), and a simple mutual action plan so procurement knows timing. Also please attach any SOW/standard pilot terms.

Appreciate it — Rachel

Rachel Lin
Head of Platform Integrations, NovaCorp
+1-415-555-0192

---
Attachment: nova-context-samples.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on token profile and pricing (post-call)

Rachel — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the sample CSV. This helped a lot. Below is a concise mapping + three blended pricing scenarios (conservative/expected/upside) and a recommended path to reach the $/1M target bands you mentioned.

Mapping & recommended model strategy:
- 8k model (primary): handle the 70% short-context interactions; use for low-latency flows.
- 32k model (secondary): for the 25% extended context; use slightly higher throughput instances and aggressive KV/prefix caching.
- 128k model (on-demand): for the 5% large-document summaries; recommend cold-start friendly routing to avoid high steady-state cost.

Token math (from your averages):
- Avg prompt = 95 tokens; avg completion = 640 tokens → avg 735 tokens per interaction.
- Avg interactions per MAU per month = 1.8 * 2.7 ≈ 4.86 interactions → ≈ 3.57k tokens per MAU/month.

Volume estimates (restate):
- Conservative: 50M tokens / month
- Expected: 320M tokens / month
- Upside: 1.2B tokens / month

Blended pricing examples (illustrative — final pricing requires commit levels and region):
- Scenario A (Conservative, no commit): suggest $520 per 1M tokens (higher due to low volume). 
  - Monthly bill @50M = $26,000
- Scenario B (Expected, 12-month commit): blended target $360 per 1M tokens (mix: 70% 8k @ $300/m, 25% 32k @ $420/m, 5% 128k @ $1,200/m → blended $360).
  - Monthly bill @320M = $115,200
- Scenario C (Upside, annual commit + dedicated pool): blended $240 per 1M tokens (volume pricing + dedicated capacity discount).
  - Monthly bill @1.2B = $288,000

How we hit blended numbers (quick unit economics view):
- Baseline infrastructure footprint + quantized runtime costs drive per-million compute cost (~$120–$180 per 1M depending on sequence length mix).
- Add support/observability/SLA layer and margin to arrive at the customer-facing price.
- Commit + reserved capacity material reduces the infra delta and passes savings to you.

Risk & operational notes:
- 128k usage (though small %) can spike cost unless routed to an upsell/overage policy — recommend auto-fallback to a 32k truncation for non-critical flows.
- Caching prefixes for repeated system prompts will shave ~12–18% from tokens served in steady state. 

Suggested next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Redwood: provide SOW + pilot terms (attached draft). — ETA: same day.
2) NovaCorp: confirm acceptance of pilot scope and give sample logs for a one-week pilot (we'll use them to refine blended estimates). — ETA: 3 business days.
3) Redwood/Tech: 60-minute scoping call to confirm SLA, region, and routing policies (include engineering & procurement). — ETA: schedule this week.
4) Procurement: draft PO / commit level conversation after pilot (Marissa will assist).

See attached SOW draft and our quick calculator; I've also attached a CSV that maps your sample lines into token buckets. If this direction looks good, we can target a 2-week pilot starting next Monday.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0123

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on token profile and pricing (post-call)

Logan —

Appreciate the rapid breakdown. Two quick notes from procurement: 
- Finance would be comfortable with a blended $350 / 1M tokens if we can lock a 12-month commit and a pilot whose results validate the 32k/128k split.
- Procurement prefers a short pilot SOW (2 weeks), then a 30-day PO turnaround.

Can you confirm whether a blended $350 is achievable at 12-month commit with our expected profile, and whether Redwood will accept the pilot-to-PO cadence above? If so, we'll circle the budget owner and legal.

Thanks,
Rachel
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@novacorp.com>, procurement@novacorp.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on token profile and pricing (post-call)

Rachel / Procurement team —

Good news: we can target the blended $350 / 1M for a 12-month commit at your expected profile (we'll need to validate with the pilot). Proposed adjustments to finalize: 
- 12-month commit band: target 320M/month baseline with a 15% overage tier.
- Blended calculation: 70% 8k @ $290/m, 25% 32k @ $420/m, 5% 128k @ $1,050/m → blended ≈ $349.25 / 1M tokens.

Action items I will own this week:
- Finalize and send updated SOW with pilot success criteria and PO timeline. (Attachment: SOW-Redwood-NovaCorp-draft.pdf)
- Set up the scoping call with our infra lead (Karthik) to validate region/latency requirements and any HSM/KMS needs.

If procurement is aligned with the pilot → 30-day PO cadence, we can lock pricing and spin up a dedicated pilot project. Marissa will help with billing/commercial terms.

Thanks — please confirm if the 320M baseline + 15% buffer matches procurement's internal forecast so I can bake it into the SOW.

Logan
